messages.text: how to do I find out which batch my Harlo B30 order belongs to

I can check that for you. Send me your order number (it looks like Shop····) and one detail from the order: the name it ships to, the postcode, or the email. I'll tell you which batch your B30 is in and when it ships.

You can also check it yourself on our shipment status page: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Each batch card there shows the last order number it covers. Orders ship oldest first, so if your order number is at or below a card's cut-off, your B30 is in that batch.

I've found your order, Shop····. It has the Harlo B30 and the Harlo OS Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA. It's paid and hasn't shipped yet.

Your B30 ships November 30, 2026. That's the Batch 5 date.

You can follow that batch on its way to our warehouse on the shipment status page: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Tracking will come to you by email as soon as your miner ships.
